headline.zh: 算法工程与服务端系统。

intro.en: Commerce student at the University of Melbourne. Each project below ships its tests in its repository, with its decision log or its pre-registration.
intro.zh: 墨尔本大学商科在读。下面每个项目的仓库里都有测试，以及决策记录或预注册文件。

body.en: Recommendation, off-policy evaluation and retrieval. Two-tower recall, gradient-boosted ranking and uplift models, labelled by evidence tier; a pre-registered recheck of the Open Bandit benchmark, where the IPS estimate pooled over the two confirmatory campaigns is 0.974 of the on-policy click rate (0.915 to 1.036 over ten-minute blocks): no shortfall shown; and BM25 and dense retrieval in Go checked against Pyserini's published BEIR numbers: BM25 equal to four decimals on six datasets, BGE-base within 0.0006 on six.
body.zh: 推荐、离策略评估与检索。双塔召回、梯度提升排序和增益模型，结果按证据等级标注；对 Open Bandit 基准做了预注册的复核，在两个确认性活动上，合并的 IPS 估计是在线点击率的 0.974（按 10 分钟时间块，区间 0.915 到 1.036），没有显示出偏低；用 Go 实现的 BM25 和稠密检索对照 Pyserini 公布的 BEIR 数字核对过：BM25 在六个数据集上四位小数相同，BGE-base 在六个数据集上相差不超过 0.0006。

body.en: A recommendation serving system in Go: retrieval, features, ranking and rerank behind one HTTP API, with the item vectors on gRPC shard replicas. In kind at 100 requests/s, through rolling restarts of the gateways and of the replicas and a bundle swap, no response failed or was degraded, with stage budgets of 100 ms.
body.zh: 用 Go 写的推荐服务系统：召回、特征、排序和重排在同一个 HTTP 接口后面，物品向量分片放在 gRPC 副本上。在 kind 集群里每秒 100 个请求下，网关滚动重启、副本滚动重启和一次换包期间，没有一个响应失败或降级；各阶段的时间预算设为 100 ms。

body.en: Go limit order book with a write-ahead command log and open-loop load testing: 5.05M–6.95M commands/s in the core, p99 1.76 ms at 10k requests/s.
body.zh: 用 Go 写的限价订单簿，带预写命令日志和开环压测：撮合核心每秒 505 万–695 万条命令，每秒 1 万个请求时 p99 为 1.76 ms。
